# Asker stärker resultatet – experterna om mellanårsvalet

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-11-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode from 4 Nov 2026 covers the US midterms, where Democrats took both the House and the Senate. That raised worries that AI and data-centre build-out could be regulated, especially after Texas elected a Democratic governor. It also covers the Riksbank raising its policy rate 25bp to 2.0%, along with several Nordic earnings reports. Handelsbanken fund manager Axel Dillner says the economy is clearly picking up and that small caps are benefiting. He is positive on Ambea, NYAB, Zaptec and Cloudberry, while EFN's editor-in-chief sees short-term risk in AB Volvo after weak North American truck orders.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AMBEA — Ambea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Guest fund holds it. Strong Q3 with higher occupancy and margins. Expects estimates and the share to rise 5-6%.

#### Reasoning

Guest Axel Dillner (Handelsbanken) bought early in the year on the view that the market overrates political risk. He says the election campaign confirmed this. Demographics, with more elderly people and too few care places, make private care operators part of the fix even for the political left. Q3 was strong, and the Humana stake is now 98%.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the political debate turns against profits in elderly care
- if a new election brings a hostile government
- if occupancy or margins fall

> *"Men någonstans att estimaten ska väl upp en 5-6 % och kursen något liknande."*

---

### 🟢 NYAB — NYAB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Record order book near 6bn SEK from Nordic grid and data-centre investment. Guest says it is well timed. Consulting is the weak spot.

#### Reasoning

Guest Dillner says the company 'is in the right place at the right time' with a record order book. The job now is to deliver it at high profitability. The CEO says margins are improving, but the 7.5% EBIT target slips to 2027 because the offshore personnel business is shrinking.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consulting/PP revenue keeps falling and drags margins
- if projects are executed poorly
- if Nordic infrastructure and data-centre spending slows

> *"som gör att det här bolaget verkligen ligger rätt i tiden"*

---

### 🟢 ZAP — Zaptec | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest's microcap fund holding. Europe's leading premium EV-charger maker. Report beat expectations by a wide margin.

#### Reasoning

Dillner says EV adoption is now clearly happening in Germany and France. Zaptec is Europe's largest premium charger maker and gains from it. He also sees companies that cut costs in the downturn getting stronger as volumes return.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EV sales in Europe slow
- if the economic recovery stalls

> *"Det syns i siffrorna idag som slår förväntningarna brutalt."*

---

### 🟢 CLOUD — Cloudberry | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest holds it. About 2 TWh Nordic power producer. Expects high winter power prices with low gas storage and empty Norwegian reservoirs.

#### Reasoning

Dillner expects higher power prices this winter: European energy and gas storage is at record lows and a dry autumn has emptied Norway's reservoirs. As a growing Nordic producer after the reverse merger with Orrön's assets, Cloudberry should be a winner.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a wet or mild winter refills reservoirs and pushes power prices down
- if gas storage recovers

> *"Och är man då en elproducent som Cloudberry så förväntas man vara en vinnare."*

---

### 🟠 ORRON — Orrön Energy | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host notes that SEB put a buy rating on Orrön this morning and that it is worth following at the open.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view: SEB buy rating. Orrön is also Cloudberry's largest owner, so it is exposed to the guest's thesis of higher power prices.

#### Sell Triggers

- if power prices fall
- if SEB withdraws the buy rating

> *"Orrön har fått en köpstämpel nu på morgonen av SEB som kan vara lite värda att hålla koll på i öppningen"*

---

### 🟠 VOLV-B — AB Volvo | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

October North American truck orders down 45% y/y, so short-term risk is higher. The base case of a strong 2027 holds, and a turnaround is possible around year-end with a dividend.

#### Reasoning

EFN editor Anders Hägerstrand says buyers are holding back over 2027 emissions rules and penalty fees, which raises short-term risk to 2027 earnings expectations. He still sees pent-up demand for replacing old trucks. If orders recover by year-end and a strong spring dividend follows, he sees a case for the share turning around near the new year.

#### Sell Triggers

- if North American orders do not come back strongly in the coming months
- if the 2027 earnings outlook is cut

> *"Vänder Nordamerika upp i slutet på året och man också kan hoppas på en stark utdelning från Volvo, vilket vi kan räkna med i vår, då talar det mycket för en vändning i axeln framåt nyårsskiftet."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Sales beat and guidance raised. A cited Nordnet economist expects a strong share-price reaction.

#### Reasoning

Cited outside view: a Nordnet investment economist expects a good share rise after strong Q3 sales of Ozempic and the Wegovy pill, plus higher full-year guidance. The hosts gave no view of their own.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales growth of GLP-1 drugs slows
- if guidance is cut

> *"tror att det kan bli en fin kursuppgång för Novo i spåren av den här rapporten"*

---

### 🟠 CLA-B — Cloetta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Profitability target reached a year early, but Q4 hit by IT disruption at retailers. Hosts will follow the Q4 sales impact.

#### Reasoning

Volume growth and margin delivery are strong. Management says the IT disruption impact is limited and temporary but gives no details, which leaves Q4 uncertain. The share traded flat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the IT disruption hurts Q4 sales more than expected

> *"blir spännande att följa hur den här it-störningen kommer att påverka försäljningen i fjärde kvartalet"*

---
